subject: Renewal options & invoice smoothing for Nimble Retail
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@nimbleretail.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal timing + expansion options for Nimble Retail

Hi Amy —

Hope all is well. Nimble's current term runs through 12/31 and I wanted to start the renewal conversation so we can lock favorable economics and avoid any disruption during your holiday ramp. You mentioned wanting to expand seats and a small uplift in capacity for Black Friday testing — we can support that.

Two paths we typically propose, depending on how Nimble wants to trade permanence vs. upfront savings:

- Path A (term commitment): 12‑month renewal with a 20% discount on base commit + priority scheduling for the Black Friday surge.
- Path B (flexible): 12‑month term with a 10% discount + $50k service credit that can be used against burst capacity or onboarding support; invoice smoothing available across 3 months.

If neither is a fit, we can craft a hybrid (partial seat prepay + temporary burst pool). I attached a draft addendum that outlines the two options and a rough SOW for the additional seats.

Can we book a 30‑minute call next week to pick one? Quick availability: Tue 11/2 10–11 PT or Wed 11/3 1–3 PT.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0199

Attachments: Renewal_Term_Addendum_v2.pdf (draft), SOW_seat-estimate.xlsx (workbook)
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@nimbleretail.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + expansion options for Nimble Retail

Hi Michael —

Thanks for sending this over. We definitely want price stability through the next 12 months; the team is nervous about variable costs with the holiday spike. A couple of clarifying Qs from procurement: 

1) If we choose Path A, does the 20% apply to list rate or to their current blended rate? We need an exact anchor for our FP&A.
2) For Path B, does the $50k credit expire? Will it roll forward if unused?
3) Can you do invoice smoothing across 4 months instead of 3? Our AP team prefers quarter‑spanning invoices.

Also, we plan to add 25 seats (approx. 2.5M tokens/mo). If we firm that now, can we get the prepay applied pro rata to the renewal period?

I can take a call next Wed 11/3 at 2pm PT. Adding contracts@nimbleretail.com to loop.

— Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Product Operations, Nimble Retail
amy.chen@nimbleretail.com | 212‑555‑0142
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:21:45 -0700
Subject: internal: Nimble procurement asks (20% anchor / invoice smoothing)

Michael —

Saw Amy's questions. Recs from pricing & ops:

- Anchor: offer 20% off their current effective rate (not list), but include a clause that gates the discount to a 12‑month committed spend >= their current FY Q4 run‑rate. That gives FP&A a clear anchor while protecting us from downshifts.
- Credit: make the $50k credit valid for 12 months and usable only against burst capacity or professional services (not token overages). Roll‑forward allowed once if both parties agree during renewal.
- Invoice smoothing: we can support 4‑month smoothing but suggest we add an early payment incentive (1.5% discount if paid in 30 days) to offset AP timing.
- Seats: if they prepay for the 25 seats now, apply pro rata to the remainder of the current term and then to the new term pro rata (show calculation in addendum).

I drafted suggested language in the attached addendum (marked). If Amy is okay, we can present Path A as the primary and Path B as fallback to keep negotiations simple.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@nimbleretail.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, contracts@nimbleretail.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + expansion options for Nimble Retail

Amy —

Thanks for the quick reply and for looping contracts. Per our call earlier today (recap below) — we captured the asks and have two clean options for your legal/finance team to review. I attached an updated addendum with the precise anchor language and invoice smoothing terms. Summary: 

Option 1 — Term Lock (recommended)
• 12‑month commitment starting 1/1/2027
• 20% discount off current effective rate (see section 2.1 for calculation)
• Priority capacity scheduling for holiday surge (70% capacity reservation during agreed windows)

Option 2 — Flex + Credit
• 12‑month term starting 1/1/2027
• 10% discount + $50,000 credit (usable for burst capacity or PS) valid 12 months
• Invoice smoothing: 4 months (Jan–Apr 2027) — early pay incentive: 1.5% if each invoice paid within 30 days

Seats & Prepay
• If Nimble prepays for the 25 seats before 12/1/2026, we will apply pro rata credit to current term and carry remainder into the renewal term as outlined in Appendix A.

Next steps
1) Please confirm which option you prefer so we can issue an update to the addendum and route to DocuSign.
2) If contracts wants redlines, point them to sections 2.1 (discount anchor), 3.2 (credit usage), and Appendix A (seat prepay calc).

Attaching: Renewal_Term_Addendum_v2.pdf (updated), SOW_seat-estimate.xlsx

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@nimbleretail.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@nimbleretail.com
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + expansion options for Nimble Retail

Michael —

Appreciate the clear options and the updated addendum. Contracts reviewed and have only minor redlines around the credit rollover language — they prefer 'automatic roll‑forward only on mutual written agreement' (we can accept your one‑time roll‑forward if you add that phrase).

We like Option 1 (Term Lock) but would ask that the 20% discount be guaranteed for the first 6 months of the term regardless of consumption drift; that gives our CFO the predictability she needs for Q1. Also, can you split the invoice for the seat prepay across 2 invoices (Dec and Jan) to help our cashflow runway?

If you can accept the contract tweak and confirm the June 2027 6‑month price guarantee in the addendum, I can get PO approval and signature by 11/24. We should be able to do the seat prepay split as requested.

— Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Product Operations, Nimble Retail

[Thread status: contracts reviewing redlines; awaiting Michael's confirmation on guarantee language and invoice split]
